description: Bass tightening preset. EQ mud scoop first, then transient-aware evening comp. Kick/bass clashes fixed with EQ, not level.
name: bass-tight
notes: Precondition: Bass track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/bass-tight.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Low boost / low-cut / high-cut are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Kick sidechain ducking is manual (no routing API); see reference file.
Dry by design: no send.set calls (sidechain routing stays manual).
